items.title: Thai Celebrities Style the New Gucci Jackie Flap Bag
items.summary: Thai edition of Harper's Bazaar rounds up looks from Thai celebrities and Gucci brand ambassadors (including Gulf Kanawut and Billkin) carrying the new Jackie Flap bag from the Primavera collection, tying the launch to the Qixi Festival gifting season and highlighting availability across Bangkok flagship stores.

items.title: Gucci Unveils Jackie Flap Bag from the Primavera Collection
items.summary: ELLE Thailand covers the Jackie Flap bag rollout, built on the archival Jackie 1961 silhouette in polished leather, suede and GG canvas, with Thai ambassadors Gluff Kanawut, Billkin, Sky Wongravee, Nani Hiranyakrit, Perth Tanapon and Santa Pongsapak fronting the local activation across Siam Paragon, IconSiam, Central Embassy and other Bangkok boutiques.

items.title: BTS' Jin, Aespa's Ningning and Xiao Zhan Lead Gucci's Primavera Campaign
items.summary: Singapore fashion outlet frames the Primavera campaign around K-pop/C-pop ambassadors Jin, Ningning and Xiao Zhan as the leads most relevant to SEA's fandom-driven audience, describing the campaign's themes of love, connection and reinvention under Demna.

items.title: Kering Closes 217 Stores as Gucci Sales Plunge 22%
items.summary: Critical-angle business coverage: Kering has closed at least 217 stores amid continuing Gucci sales decline, with CEO Luca de Meo citing Asia-Pacific store saturation and concentrating roughly 40% of 2026 closures in Asian markets, directly bearing on SEA retail footprint planning.

items.source: WWD Sourcing Journal (The RealReal 2026 Resale Report)
items.title: Vintage Demand Surges as Luxury Resale Shoppers Get Specific
items.summary: Critical-angle resale data: The RealReal's 2026 report shows the Gucci Marmont's average resale price falling from $1,600 to $853, a sharp depreciation versus strong-performing archive styles, feeding SEA secondhand-market chatter (Carousell, Vestiaire) about which Gucci bags still hold value.

items.title: Threads post: "Gucci has quietly lowered their prices and everyone is talking about it"
items.summary: Public Threads post speculates whether Gucci's quiet price cuts signal a recession indicator, new leadership direction, or retreat from years of aggressive price hikes; representative of broader SNS chatter questioning brand pricing strategy that reaches SEA audiences via reshares.

items.title: Unpopular Gucci Opinions thread (PurseForum)
items.summary: Long-running PurseForum community thread where members air candid, often critical takes on current Gucci design direction, pricing and quality versus legacy Tom Ford/Alessandro-era pieces; used here as ongoing community sentiment signal rather than a single dated post since exact reply timestamps were not accessible.

items.title: VMAN Southeast Asia Instagram reel marking Gucci's local arrival
items.summary: Regional menswear title VMAN Southeast Asia (Philippines-based, first international VMAN edition) posts an Instagram reel referencing Gucci's local presence/activation in the SEA market; engagement metrics were not visible via public access.

items.title: Gucci Debuts New Primavera Campaign Featuring Tom Brady, EsDeeKid, and More
items.summary: Style/streetwear outlet with strong SEA youth readership covers the full Primavera cast (Tom Brady, Kate Moss, EsDeeKid, Shawn Mendes, Xiao Zhan, Jin, Ningning) and Johan Renck's campaign film, contextualizing it as Demna's first cohesive brand-storytelling statement.
